detail.longDescription: 💁🏻‍♀️ TIL: 🐻🏔️ In the first # FatMarmotWeek , eight yellow-bellied # marmots in # Colorado competed to bulk up before # hibernation . A public vote crowned Dawn the winner for gaining 2 kg (4.5 lbs) and reaching 5.9 kg (13 lbs). The Rocky Mountain Biological Laboratory’s Marmot Project hosted the event to offset # research funding cuts, inspired by # Alaska ’s # FatBearWeek . 👉 https://www. npr.org/2026/08/30/nx-s1-59456 83/exclusive-meet-the-inaugural-winner-of-fat-marmot-week # wildlife # science # rockymountains # animals # rodents # nature # biology # winter
